title: Warhammer Quest: Blackstone Fortress
subtitle: Grimdark Sci-Fi Dungeon Crawl Campaign
tagline: Lead an unlikely band of explorers into a hostile, ever-shifting alien space station in the Warhammer 40,000 universe.
loreSummary: In the dark corners of the galaxy, a Blackstone Fortress drifts through the void—a gargantuan alien structure of forgotten origin. From the lawless outpost of Precipice, lead a disparate group of adventurers into its shifting obsidian labyrinth to plunder archaeotech and unseal the hidden Vault.
keyFeatures: Cooperative or solo dungeon crawl adventure set in the iconic Warhammer 40,000 universe
Dynamic exploration deck with unpredictable combat chambers, wandering hostiles, and alien chambers
Precipice trading hub: barter archeotech, heal grievous wounds, and recruit starship support
4 climactic Stronghold assaults leading to the terrifying secrets of the Hidden Vault

blackstone_hidden_vault.name: The Hidden Vault Campaign (All 4 Strongholds & Vault)
blackstone_hidden_vault.description: The complete epic quest spanning 18 expeditions to locate all clue cards, breach 4 Chaos strongholds, and conquer the central Vault.

blackstone_first_stronghold.name: First Stronghold Incursion (Exploration & Stronghold 1)
blackstone_first_stronghold.description: An introductory campaign arc establishing your explorer retinue and assaulting the first Chaos bastion.

blackstone_master_explorer.name: Master Explorer of Precipice (Vault & Escalation Quests)
blackstone_master_explorer.description: An extensive campaign marathon including side quests, hostile reinforcements, and the deepest Vault chambers.

milestones.title: Arrival at Precipice
milestones.phase: Act I - Edge of the Void
milestones.description: Assembling a mercenary retinue at the Precipice trading station and venturing into the shifting corridors of the Blackstone Fortress.

milestones.title: Breaching the Chaos Bastion
milestones.description: Assaulting the first fortified stronghold defended by Traitor Guardsmen and foul Chaos Beastmen.

milestones.title: The Spindle Drone Swarm
milestones.description: Deactivating automated fortress sentinels and retrieving archeotech clues from ancient alien machine vaults.

milestones.title: The Obsidian Gateway
milestones.description: Confronting the Chaos Lord Obsidius Mallex and claiming the final cipher key to unlock the heart of the station.

milestones.title: Secrets of the Precursors
milestones.description: Surviving the reality-bending horrors of the central Vault to claim supreme archeotech power before the fortress collapses.
